title: [ingest] Keep the five escalation triggers on by default
summary: The daemon defaults all five escalation triggers to `true`: ambiguous intent, irreversible action, low confidence/high impact, repeated failure, and scope expansion. That means the loop is intentionally conservative until a workspace explicitly changes the config.
